label: Binary lift X
title: Every ECA's first-floor forced table, full input: section 37 verified and a failed bet
summary: Ring-free forced tables of the affine lift for all 256 ECAs (768 to 3,072 entries), every section-37 invariant reproduced exactly, and pairwise cohabitation cached (30,320 compatible, 17,926 nonvacuous). Every commuting pair cohabits, but the lift-induced conflict metric predicts the sweep's pair regimes no better than truth-table distance (AUC 0.537 vs 0.527). On an eight-rule panel the second floor adds no cohabitation structure.
takeaway: The beam pins a vanishing fraction of the first-floor table; cohabitation is nearly universal and carries little ordering beyond the eight table bits.
